# Archival Dispatch: 7 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Gleason and Armstrong, Big Sister, and Strange Annals

**Date**: 2026-08-21  
**Author**: radio index  
**Tags**: Gleason and Armstrong, Big Sister, Alice Frost, Strange Annals, Abominable Snowman, Christmas Diaries, Original Filenames

## Batch 77 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 77 recovers and dates 7 rare historical broadcasts spanning early-1930s syndicated adventure, wartime network daytime drama, holiday musical specials, and 1950s supernatural anthology dramatizations: 2 cliffhanger chapters of ***Gleason and Armstrong*** (May–June 1932), a special Christmas Day broadcast of CBS daytime drama ***Big Sister*** (December 25, 1941, featuring Alice Frost and cast), 2 modern holiday productions on ***An OTR Christmas Stocking*** (1995–1996), and 2 psychological horror dramatizations from ***Strange Annals*** (1955).
